source.description: C3 auto-preparation repository casing bug found by the first real PersonalHub batch: c3_auto_prepare.repo_slug lowercases the canonical MegaVault GitHub slug and rewrites work_items.repo from gernalix/PersonalHub to gernalix/personalhub. The production Symphony bridge intentionally verifies the exact remote identity and rejects the prepared worktree with production_worktree_identity_mismatch. Preserve canonical remote_url casing while using a case-insensitive normalized key only for matching; add regression coverage.
